title: CloudNC aims to accelerate AI supply chain machining
summary: CloudNC, an AI precision machining company founded in 2015, has secured $20 million in funding led by Nimble Ventures with participation from Lockheed Martin's venture fund to scale its AI manufacturing technology across global supply chain networks.
problem_solved: Accelerates and optimizes precision manufacturing processes in global supply chains
why_valuable: Enables faster, more precise, and cost-effective machining operations, strengthening supply chain resilience and manufacturing efficiency
